stocks._: A security row of these tiers whose type is one of these. Tier A is listed on Nasdaq, NYSE or Cboe; Tier D has no exchange in the SEC file. royalty_trust, bdc and bank_nonsec are operating types the identity master knows and avo left out; an untyped name stays out until it is typed.

etfs._: An etf row that is no ETN and no CEF, with an AUM at or over aum_floor_usd, or, where N-CEN gives it no AUM, a 20-session average daily dollar volume at or over adv_usd_20d_floor. A known AUM under the floor is the answer: the volume test never rescues it.
